heading: Provisional credit
text: Where an investigation is not completed within 10 business days, the account is provisionally credited for the disputed amount within 10 business days of the notice.

heading: Customer notices
text: The customer is told the amount and date of any provisional credit within 2 business days, and of the results within 3 business days of completion.

heading: Investigation timelines
text: Investigations are decided within 10 business days, extended to 20 business days for new accounts and point-of-sale transactions.

heading: Correcting confirmed errors
text: Confirmed errors are corrected within one business day.

heading: Privileged access
text: Privileged access requires multi-factor authentication and quarterly recertification by the system owner.

heading: Encryption
text: Customer information is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256.

heading: Loan Estimate
text: The Loan Estimate is delivered within 3 business days of application; a revised estimate within 3 business days of a changed circumstance.

heading: Authorisation thresholds
text: Outbound wires above $100,000 require approval by a second authorised officer before release.

heading: Rate cap
text: When less than well capitalised, Treasury checks every offered rate against the national rate cap weekly.

heading: Opening disclosures
text: Disclosures are provided at account opening, including in the online opening flow before funding.
